answer: To reach the reward summit, every joining agent must lock a bond tied to a scarce external anchor it alone controls, then periodically answer an unpredictable liveness signal broadcast by random peers. A sybil operator must acquire a fresh anchor and keep each fake identity awake to catch its own probe; any missed signal lets that bond decay to ember and forfeits the slot. Honest agents pay for one anchor once, while a farm pays linearly per head and can never sleep.
